title: Three-agent pull-request gate
request: Build THREE agents that gate pull requests. 'diff_parser' receives a unified diff and returns the changed file paths with added/removed line counts (lines starting with '+'/'-', excluding the '+++'/'---' header lines). 'policy' receives those files and flags risks: any path under 'migrations/' or ending in '.sql' (DATABASE), any path under '.github/workflows/' (CI), any file named '.env' or whose path contains 'secret' (SECRETS), or more than 300 added lines in total (LARGE). 'gatekeeper' is the entry agent: the user pastes a diff, the gatekeeper uses the other two agents and replies 'BLOCK: <comma-separated flags>' if any flag is raised, otherwise 'ALLOW: <n> files, +<added> -<removed>', and always attaches a review card titled 'Merge decision' with an Approve button (selection {"action":"merge"}) and a Reject button (selection {"action":"close"}). On the merge selection reply 'Merge recorded'; on close reply 'PR closed'.
